quests.explanation: Mignardises (from the French for daintiness) are miniature confections served with coffee at the very end of a fine dining meal - chocolates, macarons, pâtes de fruits, and caramels. A champagne toast before dessert separates the savoury meal from the sweet finale. Personalized chocolates add a bespoke finishing touch.
